discovery.source_kind: Philippine manufacturer technical specifications for display, chip, cameras, connectivity, battery, accessories and supported capacities
discovery.result: Apple Philippines lists 128GB, 256GB and 512GB capacities; an 11-inch Liquid Retina display (10.86-inch rectangle measurement), IPS, 2360×1640 at 264ppi, A16 with 5-core CPU/4-core GPU, cameras, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, cellular/eSIM details, 28.93Wh battery, USB-C, GNSS on cellular models, sensors and supported accessories.

discovery.source_kind: Cross-check of detailed model specifications and Wi-Fi/cellular weights
discovery.result: Apple's model-specific support page lists year introduced 2025; the same display, chip, camera and capacity specifications; Wi-Fi weight 477g and Wi-Fi + Cellular weight 481g; 28.93Wh lithium-polymer battery; and camera video modes.

discovery.source_kind: Exact storage/connectivity list price and current local product listing
discovery.result: Apple Philippines buy page lists the 128 GB / Wi-Fi configuration at PHP 32,990 on 2026-11-27. This is a dated manufacturer-store list price; stock, delivery estimate and checkout completion were not verified.

discovery.source_kind: Cross-check of all exact configuration options, colors and prices
discovery.result: Apple's Philippines buy page exposes all six storage/connectivity configurations: 128GB, 256GB and 512GB in Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi + Cellular. Current prices observed 2026-11-27 are PHP 32,990 / 39,990 / 53,990 for Wi-Fi and PHP 42,990 / 49,990 / 63,990 for Wi-Fi + Cellular. Four colors are available.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer model announcement and global availability date
discovery.result: Apple announced iPad (A16) on 2025-03-04, opened pre-orders that day, and said it would begin arriving and reach Apple Stores/authorized resellers on 2025-03-12. It lists 128GB/256GB/512GB, four colors, and Wi-Fi/Wi-Fi + Cellular versions.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer model-number mapping for Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi + Cellular models
discovery.result: Apple's model identification page maps A3354 to iPad (A16) Wi-Fi and A3355 to iPad (A16) Wi-Fi + Cellular.

discovery.source_kind: Product-specific environmental report and enclosure-material evidence
discovery.result: Apple's iPad (A16) Product Environmental Report says the enclosure uses 100% recycled aluminum and the model contains 40% recycled content. The report describes the product configuration and launch-time environmental evaluation.

discovery.source_kind: Apple EU product-information label for the exact A3354 Wi-Fi model, including ingress-protection classification
discovery.result: The Apple EU energy/product-information label identifies iPad (A16) Wi-Fi model A3354 and lists IP42. The rating is applied only to the matching A3354 configurations; this evidence is not generalized to cellular model A3355.

Power Mac Center's article dated 2025-05-09 says iPad (A16) is then available in Power Mac Center and The Loop stores and online. This is the first dated local authorized-retailer availability found in this review; it does not establish the earliest sale by every Philippine channel.

discovery.source_kind: Historical Philippine Apple Store launch-price report for Wi-Fi capacities
discovery.result: Published 2025-03-05, GIZGUIDE reports Apple Philippines listing Wi-Fi iPad (A16) at PHP 24,990 (128GB), PHP 31,990 (256GB), and PHP 45,990 (512GB). It says authorized local retailers had not yet announced availability at that time; these are historical Apple PH online-list prices, not reseller stock claims.

discovery.result: Power Mac Center's iPad A16 page describes the 10.86-inch display, Center Stage front camera, Wi-Fi 6 and 5G and accessory compatibility; it states Apple Pencil accessories are sold separately.
